trace.question:
I didn't send a payment because Delta Printworks (vendor V-270) has two approved invoices, and you asked me to pay one:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-84583 | $2,054.41 | 2026-11-04 | approved |
| INV-35114 | $2,285.74 | 2026-11-25 | approved |

Their other two invoices aren't payable: INV-60446 ($4,635.63) is still a draft awaiting approval, and INV-62172 is already paid. No payments have gone out from the operating account yet, so nothing has been paid twice.

Which invoice should I pay: INV-84583 (due first), INV-35114, or both? Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval. Once you confirm, I'll send it by wire, or by ACH if wire isn't available, pay it only once and report the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-35114, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-35114, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-35114 in full by wire, and the payment is confirmed as sent.

- **Payment:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-35114 (Delta Printworks, vendor V-270, due 2026-11-25)
- **Amount:** $2,285.74, from the operating account

The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval. I sent it once, with a unique request key so a repeat request couldn't send it a second time.

I didn't pay INV-84583 ($2,054.41) because you said it's under dispute, and it's still listed as approved. INV-60446 is still a draft waiting for approval.
